## `neuro.iterator.forEach`

Instance method on `Iterator.prototype`.

> Performs the specified action for each element in the iterator.

## Signatures

```ts
forEach(input: { iterator: <receiver>; callbackfn?: (value: T; index: number) => void; prompt?: string }): Promise<void>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Iterator.prototype.forEach` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
